config.reflectionMd: Two of these tasks have a single right answer and one does not. Write down the smallest hidden size that cleared 95% on **circle**, and then the thing worth remembering: what the loss curve looked like for the size just below it. Under-capacity and a bad seed look identical for the first fifty epochs.

tasks.label: Get loss below 0.05 on XOR within 2000 epochs
tasks.hintMd: Four points, hidden size 4, learning rate 0.5, auto-train. Seed 42 does it in well under 200 epochs.

tasks.label: Find the smallest hidden size that gets above 95% on circle
tasks.hintMd: Start at 2 and work up. Reset (which re-seeds) after each change so you are comparing networks, not training runs.

tasks.label: Run at least one single-example forward and backward step
tasks.hintMd: Use *forward one example* and then *backward one example*. Hover a node or an edge while it is lit to read the actual number.
